system.monsterType: Normal Animal (Common). A mule is a crossbreed between a horse and a donkey. Mules are stubborn, and if bothered or excited they may either bite or kick. Mules cannot be trained to attack, but will fight in their own defense.

A mule is a crossbreed between a horse and a donkey. Mules are stubborn, and if bothered or excited they may either bite or kick. Mules cannot be trained to attack, but will fight in their own defense.
